page_title: CMSV7--Import local configuration to register private platform
page_content:
[TOC]

### Prerequisites:
- The device network can access the Internet normally, for example: 4G dial-up is successful or wired network routing is successful or WiFi connection is successful, refer to the "Function Usage">>>"Network Function" article introduction!

### Operation steps:
1. Download this configuration file template [Download config](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=fba8b0fb7677fb5dbec3b51ce0d656b2 "[config.zip") Unzip locally
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=439939d4aeed81dabab0f3edc233bfa4)

2. Open the text editing tool and fill in "Device number" "Connection type" "Registered IP address" "Registered domain name address" "Registered port" Parameters saved
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=80c9a8710b7eeb58d69864d9e3ba0525)
> Parameter notes:
strFD_DeviceNo="111111":Device number;
ucFD_AddressType="0":Connection type IP registration;"1"Domain name registration;
uiFD_IP="":Registered IP address;
strFD_Domain="hy.ent.cn":Registered domain name address;
usFD_Port="6608":Registered port 

3. Unlock the device, remove the hard disk or SD card storage, use a hard disk reader or SD card reader to insert it into the computer, and open the root directory of the first storage partition
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=ddb3b53476ca7b65ff891765c1a45399)

4. Copy the config configuration file you just edited and saved to this directory, disconnect the connection, insert the device and lock it
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=a337dd12622024dc88ec4cb8a3739e07)

5. When the device is powered on, it will automatically import the configuration and restart. The configuration will take effect after the restart
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=b21237b1c4c2e264213a2b122658b2b0)

6. Check whether the registration is successful locally or check whether the platform is online
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=6b3946a1f7e49bfa6ab906d767910e9b)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=66fd08fcec8c9e37a6fbc9776ff042eb)
